title: YourMondayMotivator: You are alone.
html:
You might have read today's subject line and thought, "Great Glenn. That really inspires me on a Monday morning", bear with me though.

In my opinion you are alone. Wherever you are and whatever you are doing you are completely alone. Here is a quick example. You're reading this right now and if you are concentrating on reading you will be blocking out everything around you. Say someone called your name right now would you react to them straight away?

Generally the answer is no. If you are concentrating you will appear to be in your own cone of silence. Although it seems we are all love company most of our best moments of inspiration come when we are alone.

And yet we seem to fight being alone.

If you've got to here, thank you, I am about to make my point.

To me knowing that you are all alone is empowering.

Because if you really take this idea on board, then plainly you are the one who makes the choice who and what you become.

That is a big idea. A great idea and one that I believe can help drive you to bigger and better things for yourself, your family and your community. I'm going to leave it there because I'm still thinking about it and I think you should too.
